name: Manufacturing Product Substitute
description: The Manufacturing Product Substitute app allows manufacturers to easily add or replace substitute products in Bills of Materials (BoMs) and Manufacturing Orders (MOs). It helps maintain smooth production when materials are unavailable by managing alternative components efficiently. Users can control substitute access, add replacements directly in MOs, and improve flexibility without changing the original BoM. This app enhances productivity, ensures continuity, and simplifies manufacturing operations.
summary: The Manufacturing Product Substitute app enhances manufacturing flexibility by enabling easy management of manufacturing substitutes, product substitutes, and BoM substitutes within Odoo MRP. Improve material substitute handling and substitute management for smoother production workflows. With features that boost manufacturing flexibility, productivity, and efficiency, this app simplifies BoM management, allowing users to add or replace components effortlessly. A must-have tool for modern Odoo manufacturing environments seeking smarter production substitute management and seamless substitute feature control.

name: POS Product Offer
description: This module extends Odoo Point of Sale by adding smart promotional rules allowing discounts or free items directly linked to products. It supports two offer types: Discount on Product and Complimentary Item on Purchase.
summary: The POS Product Offer Management module for Odoo is designed to empower retail and sales businesses by automating product-based promotions directly within the Point of Sale (POS) system. This module allows store owners to configure and apply dynamic promotional rules that enhance customer engagement, boost sales, and streamline discount management during checkout. Once offers are configured in the backend, they seamlessly integrate into the POS interface. Products with active promotions are visually highlighted using an “Offer” label, helping cashiers and customers easily identify them. When a qualifying product is added to a POS order, the system automatically applies the correct discount or adds the complimentary product at no cost. This real-time automation ensures accuracy, improves checkout efficiency, and minimizes the need for manual intervention. Beyond POS functionality, the module also supports detailed backend tracking of promotional transactions. Every sale reflects the applied discounts and free products in the order details, ensuring transparent reporting and simplified accounting reconciliation. name: POS Hide Product Information
description: Overview  The POS Hide Product Information module for Odoo allows you to control the visibility of sensitive product data in the Point of Sale interface.
summary: The POS Hide Product Information module for Odoo is a powerful and flexible tool designed to enhance data security and user control within the Point of Sale (POS) interface. In many retail environments, sales personnel or cashiers use the POS system daily, but they do not necessarily need access to sensitive product information such as cost price, profit margin, or internal stock levels. This module helps businesses maintain confidentiality and prevent the accidental disclosure of internal financial data by allowing administrators to selectively hide product details in the POS view. With this module installed, administrators can easily configure which information should be visible or hidden in the POS product information popup. This configuration is found under Settings - Point of Sale - Hide Product Info in POS. From there, users can enable or disable multiple options such as hiding product inventory details, financial data, pricing information, order summaries, and edit/replacement buttons. Each option works independently, providing full flexibility to adapt to different operational or privacy needs.
